note: Description taken from Holmgren's 1910 original description of Eutermes Jaraguae (in German), including the soldier and worker; alate unknown; type locality Jaraguá, Santa Catarina, Brazil. The original is in German and the BHL scan OCR is only moderate: decimal points are often misread as commas or colons and some measurement digits are blurred; blurred values are not cited. The species was then placed in Eutermes and is now in Nasutitermes.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: A small species, soldier body length only 3.5 mm and head length 1.35—1.55 mm; head capsule orange-yellow with a brownish nasus, body and legs with only sparse bristles; head oval, nasus rather narrow and rather long, frontal outline with only a very weak elevation at the base of the nasus; antennae 13-segmented (segment 3 slightly longer than segment 2, segment 4 shorter than segment 2).

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule orange-yellow, nasus brownish; abdominal tergites rusty yellow to rusty brown, sternites rusty yellow. Head only sparsely bristled; abdominal tergites microscopically hairy and with marginal bristles. Head oval, nasus rather narrow and relatively long; frontal outline with a very weak elevation at the base of the nasus. Antennae 13-segmented: segment 3 slightly longer than segment 2, segment 4 shorter than segment 2. Pronotum strongly saddle-shaped, anterior margin not concave. Measurements: body length 3.5 mm; head length 1.35—1.55 mm (the most frequent value probably 1.45—1.50 mm); head width 0.75—0.90 mm (most frequent 0.85—0.90 mm).

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Vertex plate and transverse band chestnut-brown, head capsule sutures white; postclypeus, genae, mouthparts and antennae white-yellow to rusty yellow; body rusty yellow, paler below. Head sparsely bristled, abdominal tergites more densely hairy with indistinct marginal bristle rows. Head relatively small, broadly oval to rounded-square; sagittal suture wider than the transverse suture; frontal marks elongate; postclypeus almost as long as half its width. Antennae 14-segmented: segment 3 distinctly shorter than segment 2, segment 4 indistinctly shorter than segment 3, segment 5 distinctly longer than segment 4. Pronotum strongly saddle-shaped, anterior margin distinctly concave. Measurements: body length about 3.5 mm; head length about 1.33 mm (head width blurred in the OCR and not cited).
